svg.title: allmight: ALLMIGHT raises a web application out of bare ground
svg.desc: ALLMIGHT, an original towering figure cloaked in woven specification pages, raises a complete web application out of bare ground in a single motion and holds it aloft as a living structure while a browser agent walks its lit halls. Four trajectory threads rise from the empty workspace at the figure's feet and one burns white. Beside them stand a ledger, an anvil, and a lens.
svg.text: Benchmarks for building a web application from nothing.
